[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"1. **Capture context**: obtain a full request snapshot at the main session's model-request extension"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" point, including the system prompt, user messages, assistant responses, existing tool calls and res"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ults, and tool definitions.
2. **Check at intervals**: by default, steps 7, 13, 19, and so on are el"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"igible in each turn. One model step may include several tool calls; individual tool calls do not cou"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"nt as steps. The step count restarts on a new turn.
3. **Observe independently**: copy the main requ"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"est and append an observer prompt as the final user message, including reminder rules and Seen and K"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"nown topics. Observation runs in the background while the main task continues.
4. **Show notes selec"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"tively**: stay quiet when there is nothing worth surfacing. Show at most one note per turn, which yo"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"u can expand, respond to, or bring into the main session."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The observer reads existing context. It does not execute tools, read new files, or write observation"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" requests and responses into the main conversation. Following the main model preserves the request p"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"refix so the provider can attempt cache reuse; actual cache hits and pricing depend on the provider."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Check limits, skipped checks, and ignored notes"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- Checks count separately for each user-task turn. A started check counts even if it fails, is cance"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"lled, or produces no note. Explanations do not count. Reloading the plugin does not reset the curren"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"t turn's count.
- One check can involve up to two model generations, so the check limit is not a lim"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"it on model calls or token usage.
- Checks are skipped for child-agent sessions, sessions without an"},{"id":"p33s5","text":" online display, existing notes, checks already in progress, turns that have already shown a note, o"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"r an active ignore backoff. Ending a turn does not trigger an extra check.
- An unexpanded note clos"},{"id":"p33s7","text":"es after two effective user inputs. Starting with three consecutive ignored notes, the plugin skips "},{"id":"p33s8","text":"1, 2, 4, 8, and then at most 16 subsequent eligible checks. Active interaction resets the backoff. E"},{"id":"p33s9","text":"xpanded explanations stay open.
- Dismissal offers feedback for 20 seconds; a new turn also closes t"},{"id":"p33s10","text":"hat feedback. Minimizing the panel does not count as ignoring it."}],"truncated":true}
